description: This file implements a TodoMVC application using AngularDart. It defines classes for item management, storage persistence, and the controller logic for task manipulation.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: Handles loading and saving Todo items to local storage.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents a todo item with title and completion status.

classes.name: TodoController
classes.description: AngularDart directive managing todo list interactions and state.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Loads todo items from local storage, returning a list of Item objects.

methods.name: saveItems
methods.description: Saves the list of items to local storage.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an Item instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes an Item to a JSON map.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Item.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the item title.

methods.name: TodoController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller, loading items, and setting up watchers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new item to the todo list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the todo list.

methods.name: clearCompleted
methods.description: Removes all completed items from the list.

methods.name: remaining
methods.description: Returns the count of incomplete items.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Returns the count of completed items.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns the total number of items.

methods.name: get allChecked
methods.description: Checks if all items are marked as completed.

methods.name: set allChecked
methods.description: Marks all items as completed or not.

methods.name: editTodo
methods.description: Begins editing an existing todo item.

methods.name: doneEditing
methods.description: Finishes editing and saves or deletes the item if empty.

methods.name: revertEditing
methods.description: Reverts edits to an item back to its previous state.
